tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search 2497 readings taken from 234 arXiv papers' LaTeX source: citation stances (adopts, extends, disputes, measures against) and stated assumptions. Matches on the quoted sentence, the cue phrase that decided it, and the work cited. Returns the sentence verbatim with a link to the exact line.

tools.name: read_paper
tools.description: Everything Keystone reads out of one arXiv paper: what it adopts, extends, disputes and measures against, and the assumptions it states with a citation, its own evidence, or nothing at all. tools.name: list_disagreements
tools.description: Every sentence in the library where a paper says prior work is wrong, or puts itself beside it to win. Small on purpose — disagreement is rare and concentrated, and the whole set is readable.
